name: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM 2017 (public domain), USGS NAIP imagery (public domain), team race-logger GPS centreline

notes.centre: GPS-driven line moved toward the imagery midpoint by a smooth penalised fit; corner radii within 25 % of the driven line; 18 Oct 2026: moved along its normals toward the painted road midpoint traced on Google z20 imagery (tools/track/rebuild_from_paint.py; the logged GPS line cut every corner by 2.5-5.6 m), then resampled to n equal stations (spacing L/n)
notes.edges: painted road edge (white line / kerb / verge / dirt boundary) traced on Google z20 imagery, 18 Oct 2026; unmeasured stations keep the NAIP edge; pit-lane joins keep the old edge; profile re-sampled from DEM + lidar
notes.bridge_fix: 18 Oct 2026: bridge-shadow edge kinks removed under 4 bridges (fix_bridge_edges.py, win 35)
notes.edge_waves: 18 Oct 2026: edge notches/waves removed (fix_edge_waves.py notch 0.35 len 25 sigma 5.0 slope 0.1)
